haiku.problem: The question says "When someone has wronged you," but verse 9 only mentions "an offense." The verses don't say the offense was against the person asking, so the question adds a fact not in the lesson.

The passage's title, "A Friend Loves at All Times" (card 2-16), is the central point of the lesson, but this question covers only the second half of verse 17. The title line is the more important fact to ask about.
